# INDYANASTUDIO

> INDYANASTUDIO is the photography studio and business of Indyana Balasse, based in Belgium. Services: studio portrait, creative and maternity photo shoots, event and wedding photography, a live photobooth, and a 150 m2 photo/video studio for rent.

## Services

- [Studio portrait shoots](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/packaging/shooting-studio): Portrait, creative and maternity sessions at the studio. Half-day package, 5 delivered photos, from €350. Full-day package, 12 delivered photos, from €475. Styling and make-up add-ons available.
- [Event photography](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/packaging/shooting-evenement): Wedding, birthday, festival and corporate event coverage, half-day or full-day, edited photos delivered quickly.
- [Fun Photo Booth](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/packaging/photobooth): Live photobooth for weddings, birthdays and corporate parties. Indyana shoots guests in person throughout the event, with a themed set and costumes/props provided.
- [Studio rental](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/studio): 150 m2 studio with up to 5 m ceiling height. Includes a 3-meter backdrop or brick wall, adjustable natural light, a lighting kit (softbox, reflectors, flashes), tripods, Wi-Fi, sound system, make-up corner, garden, fully equipped kitchen and shower.
- [All offers](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/packaging): Overview of every booking option.

## Portfolio

- [Portrait](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/portrait): Artistic and conceptual portrait photography.
- [Evenementiel](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/evenementiel): Concerts, open airs and festival photography.
- [Corporate](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/corporate): Corporate team and professional portrait photography.
- [Sante](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/sante): Sports training and physiotherapy photography.
- [Famille](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/famille): Family and maternity photography.
- [Fun Photo Booth](https://www.indyanabalasse.com/fr/portfolio/fun-photo-booth): Wedding photobooth galleries.
